dota 2 is a psychosis simulator

having played since 2013 when i recieved my key ive seen the game transform from what it was to what it is now
watch the game have 0 cosmetics to 10,000 just like tf2

but the grave disparity between the two, when you see a guy in tf2 with 10k hours, you always see that guy at the top of the leaderboard,hes destroying everybody because hes played the game for 10k hours

when you look at your teammate, the guy that isnt paying attention to anything, not looking at their minimap, not paying attention to pings or commands, that teammate that leaves you behind mid team-fight as the enemy team is dying

the person that is the first to instantly call everyone bad, yeah, you guessed it, the 10k hour player. 

for some reason  at the 10k point or slightly below it in my experience the players brain just, entirely melts, they lose all executive function, they dont comprehend that going to that same spot that they died 5 times in a row might be a bad idea

it blows my mind how many players with less than 1k hours have more brains than people who destroy my playtime, and im not pro all the time either, but with the severtity of bad plays ive seen I have to imagine that it actually *hurts* the pesron to play this bad, but yet they persist, 10 thousand hours having learned nothing

its genuinely like, painful, you see a guy doing so bad that you actually dont want to say anything because you assume they're a new player, and then they have 15k hours and you just lose all form of faith in humanity itself

10/10 would lose my mind to the madness of dota 2 again

absolutely terrified of the day i hit 10k hours because i think my brain is just gonna flatline and ill forget how to play like everyone else...

You can easily tell how incompetent and useless Valve is just by looking at Dota 2's behavior score system. Even if you do nothing wrong, your four teammates report you, and you end up trapped in low-behavior matches full of toxic and clueless players. And because these same people keep reporting you, you stand zero chance of escaping that pool. Whenever a game is lost, everyone just blindly reports each other—it’s a completely broken system. Thanks Gabe, you’ve proven your incompetence once again.
